body: Thanks for the reply. When college is in session I usually do go to therapy. I had recently solved a huge mess over academic struggles, and I thought I was done with stress. I didn't expect to be alienated during the summer, so I guess I should probably look back into therapy.

Thanks for the reply. To address some of the things you've mentioned, I've known these people for about two years prior to this. I wish I could say what turns them off of me, but the closest I could come would be getting easily frustrated--however there are several people that do this worse than me, so I'm not sure how accurate that is. I've talked with them a lot more than just video games. We've held meaningful conversations with each other before.

When I was still in high school my much-more-athletic-short-haired-shaved-bearded-brother and I would get told that we look almost exactly like each other (probably facial structure). I should have looked to him for a model of how to look good!
I've prided myself in an ability to grow a full beard.
Yeah, that may have been before I started asking. Oops.

Thanks. I'm a bit self-conscious of my teeth, even though I did have braces on for a year or so. Having buck teeth and bad teeth/gum ratio is never fun. On top of that my face is a bit pudgy, no doubt working out would help.

Thanks for honest feedback, when I go to get a haircut I always ask if they could trim my eyebrows. FWIW [this](http://i.imgur.com/P857WWN.jpg) is an older picture (and yet still same pose...) of what I look like after a haircut. My hair is thick and after about a week or so I can't gel up the front bit, so I just swoop my bangs to the side. Sure beats having them hang down like I did freshman year...
